[Unit]
Description=Stillyard standalone Linux scheduler

[Service]
Type=simple
ExecStart=/usr/bin/python3 "/home/runner/.local/share/stillyard/libexec/native-linux-service.py" --root "/home/runner/.local/share/stillyard" --executors "/sys/fs/cgroup/user.slice/user-1001.slice/user@1001.service/app.slice/stillyard.service/executors" --ram-mb 4096
WorkingDirectory="/home/runner/.local/share/stillyard"
Environment="XDG_DATA_HOME=/home/runner/.local/share"
Delegate=cpu memory pids
DelegateSubgroup=manager
Slice=app.slice
KillMode=process
OOMPolicy=continue
TimeoutStopSec=infinity
Restart=no
UMask=0077
UnsetEnvironment=STILLYARD_STORE STILLYARD_ENDPOINT STILLYARD_JOB_ID STILLYARD_ATTEMPT STILLYARD_INVOCATION_ID STILLYARD_ROLE

[Install]
WantedBy=default.target
